entities.name: 22 kDa alpha-zein 4
observations: Exact sequence match to the query: 266 aa, 100% identity and 100% coverage; reviewed UniProt entry O48966 from Zea mays.
Annotated function: major seed storage protein.
N-terminal sequence is consistent with secretory targeting, while the mature region is rich in glutamine/leucine/alanine and contains repeated zein-like motifs.
Pfam Zein domain PF01559.22 spans positions 23–266.

entities.name: Query zein sequence
observations: Length 266 aa; predicted molecular weight 28.9 kDa; theoretical pI 9.30.
Sequence analysis identified a likely N-terminal signal peptide followed by a glutamine-rich repetitive zein domain.
No evidence in the retrieved annotation supports enzymatic catalysis, transmembrane receptor activity, or a catalytic cofactor.

entities.name: Seed nutrient reservoir
observations: The matched alpha-zein proteins carry GO nutrient reservoir activity (GO:0045735).
